reviews.title: Rip off
reviews.text: Wants personal info to even allow you to use the free version. A subscription for an app that should be a one time purchase paid once IN the App Store. These teleprompter apps are a joke. Developer responses are rude and unhelpful. Do not give these people your money. I found a teleprompter app that does everything I need for free because I refused to pay for these expensive teleprompter apps. Keep looking!

reviews.title: Sucks
reviews.text: Unadulterated garbage. Limited on features that one can use that should be free of charge. Doesn’t have the functions that I was using before on the previous one doesn’t allow me to have a back screen like I did on the previous one. It’s just basic PS that’s not worth it at all trying to force people to go spend money on the expensive features. I mean it’s really ridiculous. Really ridiculous.

reviews.title: Year Five and I hate it more every single day
reviews.text:
UPDATE:Now they’re charging for basic teleprompter use. What’s the point of the entire app if the main features is teleprompting? Also $60/year ?? Are the owners really that broke and desperate to charge annual for a one time charge type of service? I hope this app crumbles as quickly as their careers have. 

The app consistently freezes losing all of my content. I’ve been using this app for five years and I have never hated an app more in life than this one. They never update the software and the saving capabilities for the videos always ends up crashing and you lose ALL of your content and videos. Hate this app, go somewhere else to make a purchase and save yourself the stress of a mediocre teleprompter app.
